# Harvi

> Harvi is a full-service technology and software engineering company specializing in AI solutions, custom software development, web application engineering, and mobile app development.

## Core Services
- [AI Solutions](https://harviitsolutions.com/services/ai-solutions): Custom AI agents, LLM integration, workflow automation, and predictive analytics.
- [Software Development](https://harviitsolutions.com/services/software-development): Enterprise-grade backend architecture, SaaS platforms, APIs, and cloud systems.
- [Web Development](https://harviitsolutions.com/services/web-development): High-performance Next.js and React web applications engineered for speed, accessibility, and SEO.
- [Mobile App Development](https://harviitsolutions.com/services/mobile-app-development): Native and cross-platform iOS and Android applications.
